facts.text: W Doha is in the heart of West Bay.
facts.excerpt: where lifestyle luxury meets bold design in the heart of West Bay

facts.text: The hotel offers easy access to the Corniche, Katara Cultural Village and the beach.
facts.excerpt: This Doha 5-star hotel offers effortless access to the Corniche, Katara Cultural Village, the beach, and the city’s most vibrant attractions.

facts.text: The Extreme WOW Suite has a hanging swing chair, an aquarium of exotic fish and a hexagonal bathtub with an Aquavision TV.
facts.excerpt: Mix up a cocktail at the fully-stocked bar, tune into amazing in-room entertainment, kick back in the comfy armchair or hanging swing chair in a uniquely designed area adorned with cool touches, such as a stunning aquarium filled with exotic fishes

facts.text: The spa is described as the largest Sisley Spa worldwide.
facts.excerpt: opening the doors to the largest Sisley Spa worldwide in the heart of Doha.

facts.text: Sisley Spa treatments combine plant-based science with luxurious techniques.
facts.excerpt: Every treatment is designed to combine plant-based science with luxurious techniques that restore balance, enhance radiance, and deliver visible results.

facts.text: Market by Jean-Georges, inspired by traditional souks, mixes international cuisine with local Arabian flavors.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by the traditional souks and the cultural heritage of the Middle East, Market by Jean-Georges mixes international cuisine with local Arabian flavors.

facts.text: Wahm bar has international DJs, shisha and cocktails, indoors or outside by the pool.
facts.excerpt: Follow the beats to Wahm bar where international DJs spin soulful sounds, savory bites delight, shisha smoke rises and cocktails are served with twists.

facts.text: The pool has panoramic views of Doha's skyline.
facts.excerpt: With panoramic views of Doha's skyline, our swimming experiences redefine leisure

facts.text: Guests have access to Doha Beach Sands, minutes away.
facts.excerpt: Your room unlocks more than comfort, enjoy complimentary access to Doha Beach Sands.

facts.text: The Residences have fully integrated kitchens, laundry facilities and a separate entrance and reception.
facts.excerpt: Domesticate as you luxuriate in every amenity you’ve ever dreamed of, from fully-integrated kitchens with modern appliances and complete laundry facilities

facts.text: The WOW Suite has floor-to-ceiling windows with ocean views.
facts.excerpt: With all-the-way-up-to-there floor-to-ceiling windows, this idyllic retreat is miles away from the everyday with spectacular vistas of the ocean

facts.text: The gym looks out over Doha's skyline.
facts.excerpt: Immerse yourself in breathtaking panoramas of Doha's skyline as you embark on your fitness journey.

facts.text: The hotel apartments are designed for longer stays or family getaways.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy our luxury hotel apartments curated for longer stays or family getaways in Doha.
